name: Evil Stone
source:
Hero is the Incubus of the red ball who can not move himself, but can possess any human who holds the stone to get information from that person.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是寄宿在红色宝珠中的梦魔。他无法自行移动，却可以附身于任何拿起宝珠的人，并从那个人身上获取情报。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1989.html]vndbreview[/url]]
